messages:
Marta: quick heads-up — planning to publish Py/TS SDKs tomorrow 02:00 UTC. We need to rotate the release signer keys before the push and pin the legacy sync client dist-tags. If we rotate keys we'll likely need to republish wheels and npm packages with new signatures. Don't want installs to break. Any objections?
Kevin: what's the rollback plan if npm publish or wheel upload fails? can deploybot auto-retag back to old sha?
DeployBot: publish pipeline scheduled: 2024-06-15T02:00Z. Steps: build wheels -> upload -> npm pack -> npm publish. Current flags: DRY_RUN=false. I can run retag/republish jobs if a rollback is triggered.
Sam: prefer a small canary cohort first (5% of CI consumers). QA needs a freeze on docs + a short deprecation blurb for legacy sync client before final promote.
Jin: for key rotation — do we have a grace overlap? my preference: keep old signer valid for 72h after new key goes live to avoid signature/verify churn. That gives time for mirrors/replication.
Marta: proposed plan: (1) pin legacy-sync dist-tag to old_sha (prevent accidental latest pulls) (2) rotate signer with 72h overlap (3) publish canary artifacts to "canary" dist-tag + "next" for TS (4) monitor for 60–90m (metrics + download errors) (5) promote to "latest" or rollback.
Kevin: agree. Define concrete rollback triggers: a) publish-step exit non-zero, b) >=0.5% download error rate in 10m window, c) S3 replication 404s for wheels, or d) npm 4xx/5xx spike. On trigger: DeployBot should auto-retag legacy_sha back to "latest" and create a rollback incident thread.
DeployBot: I can perform auto-retag with JOB: retag --from legacy_sha --to latest --reason "auto-rollback". Will require manual approval from @Marta for safety if --auto-approve is disabled.
Elis (QA): QA will run smoke and integration tests against canary artifacts immediately after publish and run the heartbeat monitors. Also will prepare a 2‑3 line deprecation note + migration link for release notes.
Marta: sample npm/pip commands for the run (putting here so ops can paste):
```
# npm publish (TS)
npm dist-tag add pkg@1.2.3 canary
npm dist-tag add pkg@1.2.3 next
# promote after canary
npm dist-tag add pkg@1.2.3 latest

# pip upload (Python wheels)
twine upload dist/*.whl --repository-url https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/
# pin legacy tag (internal index example)
# curl -X POST https://internal-registry.local/api/tags -d '{"pkg":"sync","tag":"legacy-sync","sha":"OLD_SHA"}'
```
Sam: docs: i'll land the migration guide PR and the short deprecation blurb today. No blocker from docs.
Kevin: i'll be on-call for the window. Quick ask: add a bullet in the release notes about the signer rotation and what consumers should do if they see signature errors.
Marta: will draft release notes and add the troubleshooting snippet for signature errors. Also adding the canary cohort timeline (start -> +1h check -> +3h promote).
Jin: one more: let's ensure artifact metadata contains signer-version header so telemetry can split between old/new verify results.
Marta: good call — ops please inject X-Signer-Version header into wheel uploads and npm metadata where possible.
DeployBot: noted and scheduled hooks for preflight checks: verify metadata, run dry-run if DRY_RUN=true, and run permission check for key rotation.
Marta: final check — anyone blocking this plan? If not, we'll pin legacy tag tonight and do the signer rotation + canary publish in the 02:00 UTC window tomorrow.
Sam: :thumbsup: no blockers from docs.
Kevin: no blockers from infra. I'll handle on-call.
Elis (QA): will stand by and run canary tests.
Marta: OK holding one more task: i'll post the final checklist + release-note draft in this thread 1h before window. If we hit unexpected publish auth failures, we will abort and move to next window.
DeployBot: reminder — I will post pipeline start/finish events in this thread during the window.
Marta: thanks all, coordinating with @Jin on signer rotation timing.
DeployBot: publish started (02:12Z) — step npm publish -> ERROR: 401 signature mismatch. Triggering hold and notifying @Marta @Kevin.
Marta: received. Hold the window, we'll investigate signature mismatch and reschedule. I'll open an incident and post postmortem notes after triage.
